notes: Refined existing stories to better align with ClinicalTrials.gov status handling and current service behavior. No new story IDs created.

change_log.value: Implement core logic to normalize ClinicalTrials.gov recruitment statuses (RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN, SUSPENDED, UNKNOWN) and assign scores (RECRUITING = highest, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING/ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION = medium-high, COMPLETED = medium, TERMINATED/WITHDRAWN/SUSPENDED = lowest). Include deterministic mapping and handling for null, unknown, or unexpected values.
change_log.note: Expanded status coverage to match ClinicalTrials.gov domain reality
Added domain service evidence to reflect true data flow origin

stories.title: Define Recruitment Status Score Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define normalized schema for clinical trial recruitment status scoring including raw_status, normalized_status (RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN, UNKNOWN), numeric score, and human-readable explanation field for downstream consumers.

stories.title: Implement Recruitment Status Scoring Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic to normalize ClinicalTrials.gov recruitment statuses (RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN, SUSPENDED, UNKNOWN) and assign scores (RECRUITING = highest, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING/ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION = medium-high, COMPLETED = medium, TERMINATED/WITHDRAWN/SUSPENDED = lowest). Include deterministic mapping and handling for null, unknown, or unexpected values.

stories.title: Expose Recruitment Status Score via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate recruitment status scoring into clinical trial objects and expose via evaluate_care_facade so each trial response includes normalized status, score, and explanation alongside existing metadata.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Recruitment Status Scoring
stories.description: Create parameterized unit tests validating normalization and score assignment across all known recruitment statuses and edge cases (unknown, null, unexpected values).

stories.title: Integration Test for Recruitment Status in Trial Evaluation Flow
stories.description: Validate end-to-end flow ensuring recruitment status is fetched from ClinicalTrials.gov, normalized, scored, and correctly returned in evaluate_care_facade responses.
